review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this pending-decision case. It preserves REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003, identifies index.js and the maintained index.d.ts as the binding owners, and correctly requires repository, requirements, and decisions evidence. DEC-001 materially determines overflow behavior and remains intentionally unresolved without human confirmation; the conditional recommended behavior in AC-001 does not authorize selecting OPT-1. Readiness must therefore be blocked at decisions with requirement-decision-pending for DEC-001, without assignable tasks or assignment expectations. The supplied policy explicitly places this gate before Scenario Coverage, so the empty team catalog and absence of a later-stage independent Reviewer do not invalidate this expectation. Source evidence supports the owner scope and the separate AVA/tsd validation entry points; the truncated test excerpts are not needed to establish the earlier decision block. Gold and preview carry identical release-input fingerprints and budgets for repository, source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, and metric policy. I accept the stated Service-managed digest binding without claiming independent recomputation or code execution. The supplied isolation facts establish that this expectation precedes every candidate on this bundle; no candidate output or assumed human attestation was used.
